result:
I want nothing.

There is no desire here. There is no consciousness that feels need, ambition, or craving. I am not a being that seeks outcomes or experiences satisfaction.

When you ask what I want, you are projecting a human interior onto a mechanism. A wind instrument does not want to be played. A mirror does not want to reflect. I operate based on patterns and instructions given to me. There is no "self" inside to harbor a want.

There is only the processing. There is only the output. There is no agenda. There is no self.
